Privacy Policy

This policy explains how My Short Stories and its publishing tool, Chikku Publisher, handle information when an authorised account connects Facebook, Instagram, Threads or YouTube.

Our principle: we use account information only to provide the publishing actions requested by the account owner. We do not sell personal information.

Information we process

When you authorise a supported platform, we may process the account identifier, username, Page or channel identifier, access token, granted permissions, media selected for publication, captions, descriptions, hashtags and publication results. We may also process limited technical logs required to diagnose failed publishing jobs.

How we use information

  • To connect the social accounts you explicitly authorise.
  • To create, schedule or publish content at your request.
  • To display publishing status and diagnose errors.
  • To protect the service and prevent unauthorised access.

Storage and security

Chikku Publisher is designed as a local-first tool. Credentials and working media are stored on the account owner’s controlled server unless a platform requires transmission for publication. Access tokens are restricted to the permissions granted by the account owner and should be revoked when no longer needed.

Sharing

We transmit information to Meta platforms or YouTube only as needed to perform requested publishing operations. We do not sell, rent or use account data for advertising. Platform providers process information under their own policies.

Retention

Authorisation credentials are retained until disconnected, revoked, expired or deleted by the account owner. Publishing logs and locally stored media may remain on the owner-controlled server until the owner removes them.

Your choices

You may revoke platform access at any time through the relevant Facebook, Instagram, Threads or Google account settings. You may also request deletion using our Data Deletion instructions.

Children

The publishing service is not directed to children under 13 and is intended for use by authorised account owners.

Changes

We may update this policy as the service changes. The effective date at the top identifies the current version.

Contact

Questions or privacy requests may be sent to mmyshortstories@gmail.com.
